# teams_virtual_appointments_policy (Resource)

Manages the VirtualAppointmentsPolicy policy via New-CsTeamsVirtualAppointmentsPolicy / Get-CsTeamsVirtualAppointmentsPolicy / Set-CsTeamsVirtualAppointmentsPolicy / Remove-CsTeamsVirtualAppointmentsPolicy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `enable_sms_notifications` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableSmsNotifications parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
